shared_tail.surface: عبيد الله بن أبي بكر بن أنس

notes: «سمع وهب بن جرير» is a link (rule 5), with Abd al-Malik as co-transmitter
«تابعه غندر ... عن شعبة» names four followers of the same saying: a variant group; the chain after Shu'ba is written once and shared
Anas is the Companion; the Prophet is the end
